decisions.statement: A reset reads the last committed page where the seat is stopped.
The seat reset is named by the first word.
A seat to reset is named as that seat's page is named.
A word past the seat's name is refused.
The code a reset runs is reached only once a reset is read.
The output a reset prints is written where the reset runs.
A reset refused after it took the agent out of the seat names each write it finished.
A reset refused before it wrote anything is refused as the fault alone.

definition: the command sitting a new agent down under everything a seat already states
